description: Defines a CartItem class representing an item in a shopping cart, including a Book object and quantity, along with methods to copy and compute total price.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Represents an item in a shopping cart with associated Book and quantity, and provides methods to copy and calculate total price.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of CartItem with optional new Book or quantity values.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Calculates the total price for the cart item by multiplying book price with quantity.
